title: MarkovProcess consumer pilot: optional stopping for Brownian motion at a truncated exit time

creators.name: Chen, Le
creators.affiliation: Department of Mathematics and Statistics, Auburn University

description:
A small Lean 4 project built on Scott Armstrong's MarkovProcess library (Apache-2.0), which did the hard part. MarkovProcess supplies the canonical Brownian motion, exit times, the heat generator and its domain, Feller regularity of the heat semigroup, continuous-time optional stopping and Dynkin's formula at a bounded stopping time. This pilot adds about 250 lines on top: a two-way bridge between MarkovProcess.IsBrownianReal and Mathlib's ProbabilityTheory.IsBrownianReal, a smooth test function, and the final assembly showing that Brownian motion started at x in (a, b), stopped at its exit time from (a, b) truncated at a deterministic horizon K, has mean x. One helper lemma (mem_of_lt_exitTimeTrunc) is adapted from MarkovProcess with Armstrong's copyright notice.

If you use this work, please cite MarkovProcess (Scott Armstrong) as its CITATION.cff asks. The mathematics is classical; this is a machine-checked consumer of MarkovProcess, not a new theorem and not a general library.

The Lean source is the source at commit 1548828e63c86f2c3f360ac46ab91ec78ba45276, which the lower-tier and comparator receipts in .lean-receipts/ cover. It was developed and verified with lean-pkg (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23272098).
references: Armstrong, Scott. MarkovProcess: sub-Markov kernel semigroups and continuous-path Markov processes in Lean 4. Software, Apache-2.0. https://github.com/scottnarmstrong/MarkovProcess
